factory_content.against_v1_20_2: v1.20.2's file is 56738 B (sha256 3582c34c...). Set 0971a5, version 15, layout 1, format 55 and the counts of patches, presets, patterns and migrations are unchanged. Bytes 64..56553 (the patch directory, every patch record, the preset section, its dictionary and the pattern section) are byte-identical, and so are the migrations and the closing 16 zero bytes. Only the released-sets section changed: 168 -> 180 B, with v1.20.2's own set inserted as entry 1 at bytes 56566..56577 (0971a5, the mask of the 12 region patches); the entries after it moved 12 B. In the header: the length (byte 12), the body CRC-32 (16..19), the released-set count 14 -> 15 (26), the migrations offset (52) and the header CRC-16 (62..63).
factory_content.why_it_differs: the v1.20.2 tag was pushed after the 1.20.2 freeze, so its own factory set was not yet in web/scripts/released-factory.json. Since then the web suite's legacy-factory test fails on any tree without it (on v1.20.2's tree too), and the rc suite must pass (D-1160). Recording it (web/scripts/legacy-factory.ts) and regenerating (npm run export-defs) adds that set to the image's released-sets section, which a firmware reads to place a factory patch new to a bank (main.c bank_add). The override test needed #1108's fix to leave today's set out, which main has. Main recorded v1.20.2 the same way in #1108. The patches, presets, patterns, set and version do not change.
factory_content.offer: an FM-1 that holds 1.20.2's region (set 0971a5, version 15) is offered nothing: the editor offers an update only for another set at a version at least its own (factory-content.ts factoryOffer).
